propositions: The retired trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with the external CI ChatOps substring matcher for 'recheck', causing unwanted Verified -1 cancellations of in-flight CI runs.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, making Gerrit comments from the bot itself re-dispatch the CI verification workflow.
The new trigger word 'rerun-llm-review' must contain no substring match with any [mapping "comment-added"] key in gerrit_to_platform.ini.template.
Retired-word comments must post exactly one best-effort refusal reply and never enqueue a review or write a label, with the refusal placed after project guard and change re-anchoring.
All contributor-facing documentation, guides, and bot reply texts must be scrubbed of the retired word and updated to the new trigger token.
Tests must validate substring-safety by parsing the ini template at runtime and asserting no bot-posted reply contains any mapped trigger word.
